messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
Yes, my husband would buy with me. I don’t know of any papers with a signing date.
The draft sounds fair to me. I would add that I hope to have money to start a dance studio, though I don’t know an amount or timing yet. I don’t have the will wording or any price or offer to share.
